paragraphs: A modern, client-side personal finance management web application that helps users track income, expenses, budgets, and savings goals — all in the browser with zero setup required.

The Income & Expense Tracker is a standalone single-page web application designed for individuals who want a simple yet powerful tool to manage personal finances without signing up for an external service. It solves the problem of scattered financial records by providing a centralized dashboard where users can log daily transactions, set monthly budgets per category, monitor spending trends through interactive charts, and track progress toward savings targets. All data is stored locally in the user's browser via localStorage, so the app works fully offline, persists between sessions, and…

The application is intentionally frontend-only (no backend, no database, no authentication), making it an excellent portfolio demonstration of DOM manipulation, state management, data visualization, and responsive UI design with vanilla JavaScript.
features: Personal monthly budgeting and expense tracking
Quick at-a-glance financial snapshot of monthly income vs. expenses
Categorized spending analysis with visual breakdowns
Learning / interview portfolio project demonstrating vanilla JS SPA patterns
